items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: Faith brought the GS up to St. Paul

ctx.x: And you were at Charlie Crest was on the St. Paul. They both docked right at the end of Olive Street to St. Louis. You see? Did they both work out from there or one go up the river usually? No, now coming up, Faith brought the GS up to St. Paul, up to St. Paul, I mean St. Paul, up to St. Louis. And then the GS was brought down from the Diodocs up in the Redempo Highway. See? And they both run out of St. Louis during the summer. Yeah. You see?
Two different excursions the same night sometime, would it be that way? That's right. I didn't know.
